name: How do I know if my damaged board needs replacement or just repair?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my damaged board needs replacement or just repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to repair or replace a damaged board depends on the extent and nature of the damage. Minor surface issues like small cracks or chips on a non-structural board might be repairable. However, if there's significant rot, structural compromise, or extensive insect damage, replacement is typically the safer and more durable solution. We conduct a thorough inspection to determine the best course of action, focusing on long-term stability and preventing recurring issues, which is a key part of our First-Party Insight in assessing damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacement is needed for significant rot, structural compromise, or extensive insect damage. Minor surface issues may be repairable.
